info.name: VideoGame Platform Backend - Catalogue Releases
info.description: Executable examples for the OpenAPI 4.3.0 GET /api/v1/releases contract implemented through the Maven-generated ReleasesApi interface and a bounded PostgreSQL page query grouped by game over an inclusive date range, and for GET /api/v1/release-calendar, the per-day game counts of one month through the generated ReleaseCalendarApi. Each release item is one game with its matching releases, and pagination counts games; a highlights-calendar day counts only games with local IGDB Hypes >= 10, while the explorer lists every qualifying game. Run against a disposable local database initialized with the tracked development seed; no provider credential or request-path provider call is required.
